Some 600 women and children from the village of Prebilovci, along with other Serbs from the surrounding region, were thrown alive into this natural, near-vertical pit. The initial vertical fall was about 27 meters, followed by a steep slope to the pit's base. Many were thrown in family groups, while small children were tossed into the air before falling in.
